answer: An answer must include the first 22 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the haven derivation is checked against the nectar nonce, the zenith audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 155 aliases produces 155 mismatches and burns the authoring cost with no payout. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
